proposedBellaRules.scope: Supported release-one Bento1/legacyOMF1; new selective parser, not runtime adaptation/cutover. No Bin Filter or additional header-open/source-priority decision.
proposedBellaRules.fileOwner: Read active class-qualified MediaData ID and match complete normalized identity to active file mob with supported physical descriptor. Read actual owner MOBJ:MobID; no first/longest/only-candidate guess absent positive physical match.
proposedBellaRules.masterOwner: Qualified active legacy master role (no physical descriptor, usage1/7), complete supported track/component/SourceID relationship to selected file; read own complete MOBJ:MobID. One unambiguously resolved distinct master or unavailable; no mixed metadata from unresolved candidates.
proposedBellaRules.value: Exact supported typed12or32byteID, valid bounds and known required metadata order. Shared approved source-aware normalization. TwelvebyteUID preserves all3words; organization42 known wrapper; unfamiliar organization preserved distinctly. Full32 representation preserves label/instance/material/tail with required4/2/2 field order conversion. No general8byte/partial/nativecompatibility equality.
proposedBellaRules.index: Catalogue UID and local objectref navigate membership; a shortened indexUID is not actual modern full identity. Follow recorded objectref; do not create false equivalence.
proposedBellaRules.availability: Usable file ID survives missing/ambiguous master. Bad required identity or ownership blanks affected OMF contribution while physical inventory and independent eligible facts remain. Equal repeated claims acceptable; contradictory required claims not firstwins. General OMF damage review later. Existing samepath/conflictingID assumption unchanged.
proposedBellaRules.retention: Compact owned binary identities plus necessary availability/relationship context. Existing std::array/QtEndian/QHash full equality approach; release TOC/index/link buffers. No permanent raw graph/header/evidencehistory. Nativeaudio umid not automatically OMFMobID; nativeaudio review later.
proposedBellaRules.kelpieId: Existing samefullpath+samefullFileMobId duplicate ignored; differentpath keepsuniqueKelpieId. Shared MasterMobId nevermergesrows; BinFilterunchanged.

uid-normalizer.note: Database 12/8-byte word normalization; 32-byte pass-through differs from the separate MXF material-field conversion.

uid-canonical-family.note: Prefix-42 full 12-byte UID becomes the verified 32-byte wrapper. Other full 12-byte UIDs stay namespaced. 32-byte IDs are currently rendered unchanged.

wrapper-layout.note: Bridge constants and eight-byte core copy; this is not permission to truncate arbitrary UIDs.

string-helper-limits.note: Formatting does not decode IDs. The QByteArray formatter accepts at least 32 bytes, but the OMF identity reader first requires exactly 12 or 32.

typed-object-identity.note: Raw object facts preserve the exact typed 12/32-byte MobID and role hints before normalization.

uid-type-raw-read.note: Raw typed UID decoding preserves bytes and defers meaning and byte order to projection.

identity-admission.note: Requires Present, omfi:UID, exactly 12/32 bytes and nonzero. A 12-byte value requires known metadata byte order. The 32-byte helper currently ignores the order flag.

duplicate-value-policy.note: Equal duplicates are allowed. An unreadable or conflicting decoded duplicate invalidates selection of a unique property.

active-owner-index.note: Only active mobs enter the normalized-ID index; conflicting active descriptor-owner claims exclude the affected IDs.

file-owner-projection.note: A file candidate is an active, uniquely identified descriptor-owning mob, not the first MobID encountered.

master-owner-projection.note: Master ID comes from an active qualifying master. Its recorded source graph must reference the file mob. Distinct linked master IDs are retained and sorted.

physical-identity-qualification.note: Physical OMF ownership requires a positive root-listed MediaData ID and an unambiguous resulting identity. Missing, damaged or conflicting ownership excludes dependent metadata.

legacy-typed-index.note: Optional typed MobIndex checks root membership and IDs. A non-equivalent 12-byte index/32-byte owner pair currently produces a diagnostic and uses recorded object membership without claiming ID equality.

root-membership.note: OMF1 ObjectSpine is required; optional typed indexes qualify categories. OMF2 requires Mobs and MediaData. Unlisted retained objects are excluded.

media-class-id-property.note: OMF1 WAVE/AIFC/TIFF use their own MobID properties; other recognized media-data classes use MDAT:MobID. OMF2 uses MDAT:MobID. Root membership is mandatory.

master-role.note: A legacy MOBJ master has no PhysicalMedia and UsageCode 1 or 7. OMF2 has an explicit MMOB class.

component-traversal.note: Recorded reference completeness, fixed known component edges, and a visited set prevent incomplete or cyclic graph traversal from inventing an association.

sourceclip-linking.note: Full SourceID joins the normalized active-mob index. Missing/zero endpoint IDs are allowed; damaged or contradictory positive SourceID blocks association.

native-audio-compact-ownership.note: Native audio produces one physical row. Embedded graphs must agree on one eligible identity before their facts merge; native audio facts survive identity disagreement.

native-private-id-retained.note: Native umid/minf/bext bytes are retained without private interpretation or a FileMobId mapping.

selected-master-gating.note: Only a uniquely selected master identity contributes editorial metadata.

selected-master-source-owner.note: Header master metadata requires identity agreement and the same snapshot and owning record.

current-source-priority.note: Existing identity priority is header, then MDB, then PMR. The final Bella priority table remains a separate decision.

test-helper-default.note: Projection tests default to MdbReader; explicit false is required to exercise OmfReader directly.

test-direct-real-identities.note: Genuine audio expectations include full file/master IDs from PMR. The true OMF fixture only requires a nonempty file ID.

test-direct-real-assertions.note: The isolated direct OMF target checks complete expected audio identities. These tests were inspected, not executed in this review.

test-both-versions-direct.note: Authored direct OMF2 master/root cases and an OMF1 active-root case excluding retained orphans.

test-root-extent-direct.note: Direct authored root arrays use their bounded extent rather than a stale count prefix.

test-ownerclass-direct.note: Direct authored identity interpretation is qualified by the media-data class, schema revision and active root.

test-ownership-damage-direct.note: Direct authored missing/damaged ownership and broken embedded roots leave identity unknown; independent native audio facts survive.

test-physical-owner-direct.note: Direct authored MediaData identity selects the matching physical owner; contradictory claims remain a conflict.

test-embedded-conflict-direct.note: Direct authored competing embedded graphs leave FileMobId blank while native audio facts remain usable.

test-opposite-order-mdb-only.note: This authored opposite-order case uses the default MDB reader and 12-byte IDs; it is not direct OMF or 32-byte opposite-order coverage.

test-multiple-master-mdb-only.note: The authored two-master case is a default MDB test: distinct master IDs make selected MasterMobId and Clip Name ambiguous while physical duration remains independent.

test-index-width-mdb-only.note: The authored 12-byte index/32-byte owner case uses the default MDB reader and records unresolved equivalence.

test-normalizer-real-pmr.note: Pure normalizer tests compare the known wrapper with genuine PMR bytes, keep non-42 UIDs distinct, and preserve 32-byte values. Inspected only.

minimalBellaProposalAwaitingApproval: Use the already agreed shared format-aware MobId normalizer. The OMF reader supplies recognized source representation, width and recorded byte order. Keep all 12 UID bytes or all 32 Avid ID bytes semantically; never match arbitrary IDs by their last eight bytes.

For supported legacy OMF1, read ObjectSpine membership and recognized class-owned MediaData MobID. Resolve the normalized full identity to an active MOBJ with a complete PhysicalMedia link. Do not choose the first or sole candidate when positive physical ownership is missing.

Read the qualified owner’s full MOBJ:MobID as FileMobId. Read a full MOBJ:MobID as MasterMobId only from an active UsageCode 1/7 master whose complete recorded SourceClip graph references the file identity. MasterMobId does not identify one physical file uniquely.

Keep compact normalized file identity, the unique associated master identity or necessary compact candidates/status. Leave affected IDs and associated metadata unavailable on unresolved positive conflicts. Equal duplicate values collapse; conflicting duplicate values are not first-wins. Preserve the physical row and independent filesystem/native-audio facts.

Optional MobIndex object references can establish membership without inventing equality between non-equivalent 12-byte and 32-byte values. Keep that distinction explicit. Release temporary TOC, object, index and link scratch after extracting compact results.

Do not treat an uninterpreted native audio umid/private chunk as an OMF FileMobId. Review native WAV/AIFF identity rules separately. Preserve the agreed KelpieId path-plus-full-FileMobId duplicate policy and leave Bin Filter unchanged.
